name: Okami no Yu ~In Yoku Zan Mai~
original_name: 女将の湯 ～淫・浴・三・昧～
source:
Naoto was on the travel to heal his heart and visits a hotel with hot spring in a countryside.
It is managed by Kaori, a sexy woman with a nice smile.
At first night, he decided to take a bath at night, then someone came in.
It was Kaori...

(from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064523]English DLsite[/url])
